# ASSA ABLOY To Acquire Gunnebo Entrance Control By Amit Chowdhry Today at 9:00 AM ASSA ABLOY has signed an agreement to acquire Gunnebo Entrance Control, an international provider of pedestrian access and entrance control systems\. Financial terms of the acquisition were not disclosed\. Gunnebo’s products include speed gates, mass-transit gates and security revolving doors used to control pedestrian access in commercial properties, public transportation facilities and other secure environments\. The business will join ASSA ABLOY’s Pedestrian business segment within its Entrance Systems division\. Gunnebo Entrance Control was formed in 1995, although its history dates to 1764\. The company has approximately 670 employees and is headquartered in Maresfield, United Kingdom\. It operates manufacturing sites across Europe, the United States and Asia\. The company generated approximately €151 million in sales during 2025 and reported what ASSA ABLOY described as a good operating margin\. ASSA ABLOY said the acquisition will broaden its pedestrian access portfolio while adding Gunnebo’s engineering capabilities, employees and industry experience\. # ASSA ABLOY To Buy UK-based Gunnebo Entrance Control For Undisclosed Terms On Monday, ASSA ABLOY AB \(ASAZF, ASSA-B\.ST\), a Swedish door-opening and access products provider, announced its agreement to acquire UK-based Gunnebo Entrance Control\. The terms of the agreement are undisclosed for now\. On the Stockholm Stock Exchange, the shares for Assa Abloy were trading 1\.76 percent higher at 359\.30 kronor\. The company expects the acquisition to have a small dilutive effect on its earnings per share\. The acquisition is expected to close during the fourth quarter of 2026, subject to regulatory approval and customary closing conditions\. Gunnebo Entrance Control, a provider of entrance control solutions, including speed gates, mass transit gates and security revolving doors, generated fiscal 2025 sales of 151 million euros or 1\.67 billion kronor with a good EBIT margin\. \"This acquisition delivers on our strategy to strengthen our position in mature markets through adding complementary products and solutions to our core business,\" says Nico Delvaux, President and CEO of ASSA ABLOY\.
